description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Evangel of Heliod with haste.
When the Evangel of Heliod token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Evangel of Heliod token and the Soldier tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
